title: GRAS Family Transcription Factor Binding Behaviors in Sorghum bicolor, Oyrza, and Maize
authors: Nicholas Gladman; Sunita Kumari; Audrey Fahey; Michael Regulski; Doreen Ware
one_liner_zh: 该文通过DAP-seq绘制三种GRAS转录因子在作物中的全基因组结合图谱，聚焦TF-DNA结合位点鉴定，但以实验测序为主、缺乏AI或物理模拟建模方法，对TF-DNA互作机制研究有数据参考价值。
abstract: Identifying non-coding regions that control gene expression has become an essential aspect of understanding gene regulatory networks that can play a role in crop improvements such as crop manipulation, stress response, and plant evolution. Transcription Factor (TF)-binding approaches can provide additional valuable insights and targets for reverse genetic approaches such as EMS-induced or natural SNP variant screens or CRISPR editing techniques (e.g. promoter bashing). Here, we present the first ever DAP-seq profiles of three GRAS family TFs (SHR, SCL23, and SCL3) in the crop Sorghum bicolor , Oryza sativa japonica , and Zea mays . The binding behaviors of the three GRAS TFs display unique and shared gene targets and categories of previously characterized DNA-binding motifs as well as novel sequences that could potentially be GRAS family-specific recognition motifs. Additional transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility data further facilitates the identification of root-specific GRAS regulatory targets corresponding to previous studies. These results provide unique insights into the GRAS family of TFs and novel regulatory targets for further molecular characterization.
abstract_zh: 识别控制基因表达的非编码区已成为理解基因调控网络的关键方面，这些网络在作物改良中可能发挥作用，如作物操作、胁迫响应和植物进化。转录因子（Transcription Factor, TF）结合方法可为反向遗传学方法（如EMS诱导或自然SNP变异筛选或CRISPR编辑技术，例如启动子敲除）提供额外的宝贵见解和靶标。在此，我们首次展示了三种GRAS家族转录因子（SHR、SCL23和SCL3）在作物高粱（Sorghum bicolor）、水稻（Oryza sativa japonica）和玉米（Zea mays）中的DAP-seq图谱。这三种GRAS转录因子的结合行为显示出独特和共享的基因靶标，以及先前表征的DNA结合基序类别，还有可能作为GRAS家族特异性识别基序的新序列。额外的转录组和染色质可及性数据进一步有助于识别与先前研究相对应的根特异性GRAS调控靶标。这些结果为GRAS家族转录因子提供了独特见解，并为进一步的分子表征提供了新的调控靶标。
